༄༅/ /sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma bzhugs so/ /shog skya'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma bzhugs so/ /

shog skya'i skor/ sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma zhes bya ba/ dpal snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thugs rje'i me 'od ye shes 'od 'phro bas/ /'gro kun sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg mdzad pa/ /bde gshegs rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud sde rdzogs pa rang byung las/ /tshe 'das phung po bsreg ste sgrib sbyong don/ /ma nor ji bzhin gsal ba'i rim pa yis/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis legs par bstan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du/ /ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba la/ sngon 'gro sta gon du bya ba/ dngos gzhi ji ltar sbyang ba/ rjes rus bu bsdu ba gsum las/ dang po la thab rtsig pa/ ro chas 'jug pa/ mchod rdzas bsham pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ sa'i stegs 'dom do la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa byas la/ theg chen bzhi btab pa'i dbus su/ me khang gru bzhi pa/ ro de nyid kyi khru skor gyis rmang bting pa'i nang du zlum skor gsum bris pa'i nang ma la rigs lnga yab yum gyi mtshan ma pad 'dab bzhi'i dbus su 'khor lo/ phyogs bzhir rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rgya gram rnams bris/ gnyis pa la sems dpa' sems ma yab yum brgyad kyi/ thig le gnyis brtsegs pa kha dog dang mthun pa brgyad bya/ gsum pa la sgo ba yab yum gyi mtshan ma dgod/ zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rje re bri/ nang ma'i mu khyud bzhi mthing ga /bar pa dmar/ phyi ma dkar pos bkang*/ ye shes kyi mu khyud lnga ldan phyi ma la bskor/ de nyid ras la sogs pas bkab nas/ sngar gyi 'phro gyen la rtse khru gang dang mdzub gang rtsigs la/ shing shug pa brla bas mi phra ba/ rtse khrur re thab kyi nang du bslang la drang por gshibs de khengs par dgang*/ phyogs bzhi'i gseng phug sa thang mtshams la gyen du mkhyid re yod pa'i phyogs su/ shing gi khong seng*/ dpal 'bar 'dzugs yod pa re bya/

mdun gyi bug pa de shing bcug pas shong bar byas la so phag la sogs pas phyi nas gcad/ rtse khru gang gi gong na mdzub gang yod sa bug pa cig byas/ yam shing phra mos zang zing du dgang*/ de'i steng nas ro khang khru gang pa zlum po'am gru bzhi par brtsig go /gnyis pa ni ro'i drung du mchod pa bshams la/ bdag nyid kun bzang yab yum du bskyed la/ mchod bstod byas nas bum par bzlas pa bya/ ro la bsang chu gtor nas/ me tog phog pa'i lhar bskyed te/ rnam shes bkug la bgegs bskrad sdig pa sbyang*/ gzungs sngags kyi bum chus bkru zhing*/ phar phyin drug dang chu bo bzhi la sogs pa'i tshig bcad brjod nas/ ā+oṃ sarba bid badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūṃ gis/ rdo rje khu tshur dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ rigs lnga'i rtsa sngags tshan pa gsum bris pa'i gcig spyi bo/ gcig mgrin pa gcig snying khar btags la mchod bstod bya'o/ /skabs 'dir dbang bskur nas lam bstan lam sbyong byas na'ang shin tu legs shing*/ ma byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de nas ro khang du bcug ste/ rol mo'i sgras bgegs bskrad la/ shing sgrom mam dur khang rgya phibs ma byed na steng nas bkab/ med na bre'i gzugs gru bzhi pa/ cung zad yangs pa gcig gam/ dang ma'i zhabs mtho gang phug pa bkab/ phyi nas du ba mi 'chor bar dres mas bcings la zhal ba bya'o/ /gsum pa ni mchod pa mdun/ sreg rdzas g.yas/ gtor ma g.yon du bsham mo/ /de'ang mchod pa ni/ mchod yon la sogs pa phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams so/ /sreg rdzas ni yam shing sor bcu gnyis pa mang po dang*/ mar dang*/ til dang*/ yungs kar dang*/ zho zan dang 'bras la sogs pa 'bru sna tshogs dang*/ ra'i 'o ma'o/ /de rnams kyi yam shing dang mar ma gtogs pa snod gcig tu bsres pa'am/ so sor bya'o/ gtor ma ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gcig /mkha' 'gro'i gcig /chos skyong gi gcig /me lha/

bzhi bdag /rigs drug /bgegs gtor dang bdun no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed pa/ mdun bskyed pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ srungs 'khor sngon du 'gro bas kun bzang du bskyed la/ ye shes pa bcug /dbang bskur mchod pa dang bstod pa rgyas par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang zag mchog la dz+wa la'i sngags tsam gyis me sbar/ phal pa la/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro/ /'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la/ /lha mo bzhi yi me sbar ro/ /dbang po drug gi bud shing la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i me sbar ro/ /yul rnams drug gi bud shing la/ /lha mo drug gi me sbar ro/ /nyon mongs lnga yi bud shing la/ /ye shes lnga yi me sbar ro/ /lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la/ /rgyal ba sku gsum me sbar ro/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis 'grub par shog /ā+oṃ badz+wa dz+wa la raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes pas mdun ngos kyi gseng nas me sbar la/ bsang chu gtor nas thab dang mchod gtor sreg rdzas dang bcas pa bsangs nas/ swa bha was stong par sbyangs la/ so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ ā+oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko ྅ haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rin po che'i thabs yangs shing rgya che ba/ sgo bzhi gru bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa'i dbus su ra skyes kyi steng na raṃ las me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa g.yas dang po pad+ma/ gnyis pa nor bu'i phreng ba/ g.yon dang po dbyug pa/ gnyis pa ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas dbyug gu'i phyag rgyas rdo rje dril bu dang dbyangs kyis/ ā+oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad sgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/

/'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ ag+ne ye ma hā te dza e h+ya hi sa ma ye dzaḥdzaḥ/ zhes pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs thab kyi dam tshig pa bskyed pa la bstims nas/ ā+oṃ ag+ne ye pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul nas ku sha thobs te/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa'i lha yang dag pa ste/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis dag byed yin/ /de yis bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /bgegs rnams med cing zhi bar mdzod/ /ces pas rtse ma nyams par dgram mo/ /de nas/ ā+oṃ ag+ne ye swāhās mar blugs gzar bdun bdun gyis bkang ba'i dgang blugs kha sbyar ba gsum dbul zhing*/ ā+oṃ ag+ne ye di bya di bya bi shud+dhe mahā shṝ ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya che ge mo'i sdog pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhās byon zan phul nas/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di/ /drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ ag+ne ye ma hā te dza ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū tsa me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes pa nas rol mo'i bar phul la/ sreg rdzas rnams kyi mar dang yam shing so sor 'bul/ gzhan ma rnams bsres la/ ā+oṃ ag+ne ye che ge mo'i sdig pa/ sarba pā paṃ shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes pas nyi shu rtsa gcig re grangs byas la dbul/ de'ang rgyas par byed na sreg rdzas rnams so sor dbul te/ ā+oṃ bho dhi pṛk+ṣa ye swāhās yam shing dang*/ ag+ne yes mar/ ā+oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hās til/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sid dha ye swā hās nyung dkar/ ā+oṃ sarba saṃ bha de swā hās zho zan dang*/ 'bras la sogs pa so sor 'bul lo/ / 'og ma rnams la'ang tshul 'dis shes par bya'o/ /de nas mchod pas mchod la/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras/

/me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur bas/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs/ /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon po'i sras/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyob pa'i phyir/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis sku sprul pa/ /rig sngags sgrub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs bsreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs/ /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan ghun+dhe bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de bas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod cing bstod nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod cing bstod pa ni/ lha rnams spyan drangs la gang zag mchog la ro dang lha rnams dbyer med la mchod bstod bya zhing*/ phal pa la lha bskyed pa la sreg rdzas dang*/ ro'i sha khrag rus pa rnams bdud rtsir bsams la 'bul lo/ /de'ang rgyas pa la dam tshig pa bskyed nas ye shes pa bstim la/ bsdus pa la ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ me lha'i lto bar bzhugs par bsams la mchod pa'o/ /de yang thog mar me lha'i lto ba yangs shing rgya che bar khro bo rta mgrin yab yum du bskyed la/ hūṃ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnod dgra 'dul ba'i/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu sa ma ya dzaḥs spyan drangs pa bstim la/

ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu/ ar+ghaṃ/ pa t+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ ghan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shabha ā hūṃ gis mchod nas/ dbang chen bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ / 'jigs byed chen po ral pa gyen du brdzes/ khro bo'i rgyan rnams ma lus rab rdzogs pa'i/ khro rgyal rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i rjes la sngags de nyid la/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ btags la/ sreg rdzas rim pas brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa phul ba'i rjes la/ hūṃ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'dzoms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pas/ /bla med dkon mchog gsum po gnas 'dir gshegs/ /ā+oṃ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ bhu dhā dharmā saṃ gha sa ma ya dzaḥs spyan drangs la/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa khro bo'i mdun du bzhugs pa la mchod pas mchod nas/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*/ /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las sgrol zhing*/ /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dag la rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan ldan/ /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod nas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya bud+dha dharmā saṃ gha bh+yo/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa phul nas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod nas/ khro bo'i lto bar zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bskyed la/ spyan drangs te bstim nas/ mchod bstod rgyas par byas la/ rnam snang gi rtsa sngags ming spel dang bcas pa stong ngam 'bum/ gzhan rnams rang rang gi sngags rnams kyis brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa phul la/

mchod pa dang bstod pa yang rgyas par byas te/ slar yang khro bo rta mgrin la/ sngar gyi tshul de nyid kyis brgya stong grangs med pa phul la/ mchod bstod byas te bgegs zhi bar gsol ba btab nas/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams la gtang rag gi mchod cing bstod nas/ /bzod par gsol te/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra muḥs spyan drangs pa rim pa bzhin gshegs nas/ dam tshig pa bsdu la yang me lha'i lto bar mkha' 'gro chos skyong yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa rim par spyan drangs te/ rang rang gi sngags sam/ ā+oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ a d+ya nud pan na twa ta ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ ces sreg rdzas phul la gtor ma yang phul te/ phrin las bcol nas gshegs su gsol la/ slar yang me lha gsal btab nas/ sreg rdzas lhag ma ci 'byor ba bdun la sogs pa phul te/ mchod pa dang gtor ma phul nas phrin las bcol te/ bstod pa byas nas/ bdag gi ( <a3gt;don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrubs kyis bzhud cig byin za khyod/ /rang gnas dge bar gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang dus bzhin ci nas byon/ /bdag gi zhes me lha'i phyag rgya bkrol la/ 'byung dgos pa thams cad mdzod/ /ā+oṃ ag+ne ye gats+tsha/) /po thams cad pa'i gtor ma byin nas bsngo ba byas te/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdag nyid bsrungs nas/ gson po don du bkra shis brjod la yon phul dga' ston bya'o/ /gsum pa ni me rnams zhi ba'i tshe/ bdag bskyed mdor bsdus pas lag pa gnyis dpung par bsnol te se gol gtogs shing*/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ye dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs rus bu bsdus la/ bum chus bkru zhing sdig sgrib dag par bsam la/ rigs lnga'i rtsa sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa brjod nas/ mchod de gshegs su gsol lo/ de ltar tshe 'das sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thabs/ /ji ltar rgyud las gsungs bzhin sbyar ba yis/ /dge ba dri med ston ka'i zla 'dra des/ /'gro kun rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog

/tshul 'di rgyal sras dri med 'od zer gyis/ /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying po'i mgul/ /o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /rin chen shog skya'i ngos la legs par bkod/ /sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma zhes bya ba/ /pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis ston gsum gangs ri thod dkar du sbyar ba rdzogs so// //bha wan+tu/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)sreg sbyong 'od kyi snye ma/ - PAGE 270 -- PAGE 271 -- PAGE 265 -
